title: Fantasia Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: A beach cottage masterpiece designed by one of Seaside's original architects! Much like the Disney animated film, Fantasia cottage is both magical and serene. Enter this 3 bedroom/ 2 bath beach house off Tupelo circle through the large screened-in porch.
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Architectural gem! Featured in Several publications, Fantasia has a fun design with many architectural details! - Access to the Tupelo private Beach Access in Seaside - You will have a total of 6 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Fully stocked kitchen complete with both a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Huge screened porch with ample seating OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) How to have a Fantasia Vacation! You may know that a Fantasia is a musical composition that is improvised and freeform (as your vacation should be)! With that in mind a very few notes to enjoy your stay; Best place to view the sunset? Trek to the 4th floor tower after sunset; the lights of the town coming on as night falls is magical. Best breakfast spot? The spacious screened front porch is ideal for morning coffee, watching the show unfold around Tupelo Circle. (Nice outdoor room to send the kids or escape them too.) Shower? Definitely the outdoor private shower; rain or shine, winter or summer it’s refreshing with a live oak canopy above. Biking? As the highest elevation in Seaside you can (almost) coast to Modica Market or the beach. Artworks? By Libby Gee Cooper (mostly). Bedrooms, Small! Master has a queen bed, bedroom 2 with a full bunk, bedroom 3 with a trundle. (Remember life can be simple.) That’s the essentials to get started. Hope you have a Fantasia stay! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: All bedrooms are located on the second level. Floor 1: Fully Stocked Kitchen, Updated Bath with Large Shower (connected to the outdoor shower), Living area and TV with ample seating including wall to wall wrap around designer bench. Floor 2: Queen bedroom Bunk room (full bed on top and bottom) Twin bedroom with trundle (sleeps 2) Hall bathroom with tub/shower combo Floor 3: Escape to the tower and viewing area for an enjoyable evening of watching the sunset! ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. **All Sandpiper managed properties come with 2 complimentary bikes** FREE WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
